integration.name: Plivo
integration.summary: A high-value US-centric provider with a Twilio-style API, which makes it a common choice for cost-sensitive high-volume traffic.

credentials.label: Auth ID
credentials.note: Plivo calls this the Auth ID.

strengths: Lower unit cost for high-volume US traffic
Twilio-style API surface, so migrations are mostly mechanical
Works well as a second route under a Twilio primary
considerations: Our default pacing is conservative. Plivo throughput depends on your account level and number type — raise it once you know your ceiling.
